title: FAO State of the World's Forests 2026: Degradation Outpacing Recovery, Only ~23% of Restoration Pledges Being Implemented
detail: FAO's flagship SOFO 2026 report, released September 28, finds about 1.56 billion hectares of land worldwide are degraded, including more than 460 million hectares of forest. 91 countries have pledged 190+ million hectares for restoration and 206.5 million hectares are currently under restoration, but only about 23% of reported forest restoration commitments are being implemented, and roughly 470 million hectares must be restored to meet 2030 targets. FAO estimates restoration can return up to USD 30 per USD 1 invested under favourable conditions, but annual finance must rise from about USD 64 billion to USD 296 billion by 2030.
